g.text: CampusClaw HTTP Session Logical Deletion Proposal
exactly one credential pair, no body
transaction: mark DELETING, reject new work,
block new Run and configuration commands
ensure active Run is terminal aborted
complete and delete cleanup work item
Physical cleanup remains retryable and internal.
mate-service Chat metadata and Attachment Service objects
are outside this operation's ownership boundary.
The permanent tombstone has exactly two fields:
Cleanup state, retries, errors, and owner data stay out.
